title: 2024 Topps Series 2 #SMLB-42 Francisco Lindor New York Mets Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2024 Topps Series 2 Francisco Lindor Stars of the MLB #SMLB-42 trading card is a must-have for any New York Mets fan. Featuring the talented shortstop in his Major League Baseball (MLB) uniform, this card is an original and licensed reprint from the Topps manufacturer. 

The card is a standard size and is part of the Stars of MLB insert set. It is a sports trading card and is not autographed. The card number is SMLB-42 and it is from the 2024 season. Don't miss out on the opportunity to add this Francisco Lindor card to your collection.
